name: Quantum Computing
tagline: From single-qubit gates to a Shor-style factoring run

milestones.title: Single-qubit superposition
milestones.objective: Apply a Hadamard gate; measure 50/50 |0⟩/|1⟩ over 1000 shots.

milestones.title: Entangle a Bell pair
milestones.objective: Apply H + CNOT to two qubits. Verify perfect 00/11 correlation.

milestones.title: Bloch sphere visualization
milestones.objective: Steer a qubit around the Bloch sphere with single-qubit rotations.

milestones.title: Deutsch-Jozsa algorithm
milestones.objective: Tell a constant function from a balanced one in a single oracle query.

milestones.title: Grover search
milestones.objective: Find a marked item in a 16-element database in √16 = 4 queries.

milestones.title: Quantum Fourier Transform
milestones.objective: Implement QFT on 4 qubits; verify unitarity to 1e-9.

milestones.title: Depolarizing noise model
milestones.objective: Simulate Bell-pair fidelity vs depolarizing rate p ∈ [0, 0.1].

milestones.title: Shor 9-qubit code
milestones.objective: Encode |ψ⟩, inject single-qubit errors, decode and recover. >99% fidelity.

milestones.title: Surface code distance-3
milestones.objective: Build the smallest non-trivial surface code; correct any single Pauli error.

milestones.title: Factor 15 with Shor's algorithm
milestones.objective: End-to-end Shor on N=15 with phase estimation.

milestones.title: VQE on H₂
milestones.objective: Find the ground-state energy of the H₂ molecule with a 4-qubit VQE.

milestones.title: Quantum-assisted market trading
milestones.objective: Use a small quantum optimisation to price a 4-asset portfolio. Beat the classical baseline by ≥1% on the simulator.
